channel.title: Frank Goortani: essays
channel.description: Essays on production AI systems and engineering leadership by Frank Goortani.

item.title: Your AI Agents Need Rules About Who Decides, Not Another Network
item.description: How people and AI agents from different platforms can coordinate through one GitHub repository, which always-on agents can take part, and the open Repo Channel Protocol.

item.title: What Is a Centaur CTO?
item.description: A Centaur CTO pairs AI leverage with human judgment: AI handles speed, analysis and execution; the CTO keeps decisions, accountability and people leadership.

item.title: What I Learned Scaling FasterOutcomes from 0 to 1
item.description: Field notes from taking FasterOutcomes, an AI platform for legal and healthcare workflows, from MVP to production: product focus, velocity and reliable AI.

item.title: The Parallel Contracts Model: A Post-Mortem
item.description: A post-mortem on the parallel contracts model and why focus became the better operating system for CTO work.

item.title: Production LLM Systems: What CTOs Need to Know
item.description: What separates an LLM demo from a production system: the CTO decisions on retrieval, evaluation, cost and observability, plus a pre-launch checklist.
